gold_statement: The system shall retain audit logs and security documentation for at least 6 years.
statement: The system shall retain audit logs and security documentation for at least 6 years.

gold_statement: The system shall lock a session after 15 minutes of inactivity and require re-authentication to resume it.
statement: The system shall lock sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity and require re-authentication to resume.

gold_statement: The programme shall eliminate faxed and paper outpatient prescriptions at all four hospitals within 12 months of go-live.
statement: The system shall eliminate faxed and paper outpatient prescriptions at all four hospitals within 12 months of go-live.

gold_statement: The system shall allow a prescriber to complete a routine prescription in under 90 seconds.
statement: The prescriber shall be able to complete a routine prescription in under 90 seconds.

gold_statement: The system shall display the patient's active medication list and recorded allergies on the order entry screen.
statement: The system shall provide a patient's active medication list and recorded allergies on the same screen as the order being written.

gold_statement: The system shall restrict access to a patient's medication data to members of the patient's care team.
statement: The system shall limit access to a patient's medication data to the patient's care team; any access outside it must be logged and reviewed.

gold_statement: The system shall display the pharmacy's response to each cancellation request to the prescriber.
statement: The system shall send an electronic CancelRx message to the pharmacy when a cancellation occurs, and the prescriber should be able to see the pharmacy's response.

gold_statement: The system shall encrypt all prescription traffic to the e-prescribing intermediary with TLS 1.2 or higher.
statement: The system shall encrypt all prescription traffic to the pharmacy intermediary with TLS 1.2 or higher and ensure integrity protection.

gold_statement: The system shall display drug-drug and drug-allergy interaction alerts before a medication order can be signed.
statement: The system shall display an alert to the prescriber if a drug-drug interaction or allergy is detected.

gold_statement: The system shall require a unique user account for every user.
statement: The system shall ensure that every user has a unique account and shared logins are prohibited.

gold_statement: The system shall let ordering continue with a formulary-unavailable notice when the formulary service does not respond within 3 seconds.
statement: The system shall perform formulary checks and continue with a 'formulary unavailable' notice if the payer formulary service does not respond within 3 seconds.

gold_statement: The system shall publish each order received over the HL7 v2 interface as a FHIR R4 MedicationRequest.
statement: The system shall publish each order as a FHIR R4 MedicationRequest through an adapter, as per S-ARCH-13.

gold_statement: The system shall return the interaction and allergy check result within 2 seconds for at least 95% of orders at a load of 1,200 orders per hour.
statement: The system shall provide interaction and allergy alerts that come back within 2 seconds for at least 95% of orders; past 5 seconds prescribers start working around it.

gold_statement: The system shall prevent transmission of a prescription that lacks the drug name, strength, dose form, quantity, directions for use or number of refills.
statement: The system shall verify that every prescription has a drug name, strength, dose form, quantity, directions for use and the number of refills authorised before filling the prescription.

gold_statement: The system shall record auditable actions on prescriptions in tamper-evident audit records that no application user can delete.
statement: The system shall maintain tamper-evident audit records and prevent any application user from deleting them.

gold_statement: The system shall allow a prescriber to cancel a transmitted prescription by sending a CancelRx message to the pharmacy.
statement: The system shall process the cancellation of electronic prescriptions.

gold_statement: The system shall block signing when an order matches an allergy recorded with high criticality until the prescriber acknowledges the alert.
statement: The system shall provide interaction and allergy alerts before the prescriber can sign the order, not after it has gone to the pharmacy.

gold_statement: The system shall reach the e-prescribing intermediary acknowledgement within 10 seconds of signing for 95% of prescriptions.
statement: The system shall enable prescribers to complete a routine prescription for non-controlled medications in under 90 seconds through the EHR interface.

gold_statement: The system shall achieve at least 99.9% monthly availability, excluding planned maintenance on Sundays between 02:00 and 04:00.
statement: The system shall be available at least 99.9% per month.

gold_statement: The system shall notify the prescriber within 60 seconds when transmission of a prescription to the pharmacy fails.
statement: The system shall notify pharmacies of prescription cancellations within 24 hours.

gold_statement: The system shall allow a prescriber to change a transmitted prescription through an RxChangeRequest message.
statement: The system shall receive prescription details including drug name, strength, dose form, quantity, directions for use, and the number of refills authorised when a prescriber requests an e-Rx.

gold_statement: The system shall require a reason selected from a coded list for every override of an interaction or allergy alert.
statement: The system shall integrate interaction and allergy alerts handling into a separate project.

gold_statement: The e-prescribing module shall be certified against ONC criteria 170.315(a)(1), (a)(4) and (b)(3) before go-live.
statement: The system shall be ONC-certified before the go-live date.

gold_statement: The system shall produce a monthly report of alert overrides grouped by prescriber and drug pair.
statement: The system shall log and audit any overrides of drug-drug interaction or allergy alerts.

gold_statement: The system shall transmit the alert override reason with the prescription to the dispensing pharmacy.
statement: The system shall provide a reason for every prescription override to the safety committee.

gold_statement: The system shall check the payer formulary for each medication order.
statement: The system shall provide real-time drug-drug interaction and allergy contraindication checking at the point of ordering.

gold_statement: The system shall send new prescriptions to the e-prescribing intermediary as NCPDP SCRIPT NewRx messages.
statement: The system shall transmit electronic prescriptions to community pharmacies through an intermediary.

gold_statement: The system shall require verification by a second licensed clinician before a high-alert medication prescription is transmitted.
statement: The system shall perform real-time drug-drug interaction and patient allergy contraindication checks during the issuance of electronic prescriptions.
